messages:
mike: Heads up — token-level latency dashboards starting ~15:07 UTC showing gaps for kernel selector and kvcache metrics (redwood.runtime.kernel_select_ms, redwood.kv_cache.hit_ratio). Looks like the StatsD -> OTLP exporter bump dropped tags.
sophia: saw that :eyes: dashboards for per-route KPIs show flat lines for kvcache hit_ratio. Is this the same as the spike we saw in the canary?
mike: yep. the canary kernel-selector rollout yesterday also included an exporter change that renames tags to 'kernel_variant'. exporter v2 currently collapses or strips tags if it detects potential high-cardinality collisions, so metrics ended up emitted without kernel_variant — our panels rely on it.
jamie: immediate mitigation? rollback the exporter or relax Grafana queries to not require kernel_variant?
olivia: we can rollback to the old exporter image quickly: `redwood/statsd-otel:2025-12-07`. @deploy-bot can you trigger a rollback? :hammer_and_wrench: 
deploy-bot: Requested rollback of statsd-otel exporter to `2025-12-07` in prod (us-west-2). Job queued — ETA ~4m.
dan: FYI pipeline sampler also dropped counts: redwood.runtime.token_latency_ms lost ~40k metrics/hour while tags were missing. We'll need a backfill/replay to restore per-kernel slices.
meera: for backfill I can replay from kafka topic `metrics-raw-v0` into BigQuery and re-materialize the kernel_variant tag with a mapping table. Will need a mapping script to map old tag keys to kernel_variant.
sophia: can we also pull perf traces around the kernel switch? without per-kernel token latency we can't validate perf regressions.
mike: grabbed some perf traces from canary nodes pre-rollback and uploaded to /mnt/ci/perf-traces/1853001234. They include KV hit/miss markers. @jamie can you run the aggregator and output a delta summary vs baseline?
jamie: on it. quick mapping snippet I'll use for the replay job:
```
# mapping rules for replay
if tag_key == 'kernel' and tag_value.startswith('kv-'):
    set_tag('kernel_variant', tag_value)
else:
    set_tag('kernel_variant', 'unknown')
```
I'll open a PR for the replay job and include unit tests for the mapping.
olivia: dashboard owners — I'll patch queries to tolerate missing kernel_variant (fallback to 'unknown') so panels don't break during the reingest window.
mike: post-rollback checklist: verify redwood.kv_cache.hit_ratio streams again, confirm token_latency per-kernel reappears in dashboards, and kick off a 24h reingest for March 9 00:00-23:59 UTC.
dan: :thumbsup: I'll start the backfill once Jamie's PR is merged. Also proposing an alert: exporter_tag_drop_rate > 1% for 5m.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed in 3m 12s. health checks: green :white_check_mark:
sophia: thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and capture follow-ups: 1) add unit tests for tag-preservation in exporter CI, 2) add a canary gating step for exporter version with synthetic metrics, 3) weekly metrics-replay smoke-tests.
mike: agreed. owners: (1) alert — dan, (2) mapping/backfill — meera + jamie, (3) dashboard fallbacks — olivia, (4) exporter canary gating — s/release infra. We'll update the PM board after the postmortem.
